born.why: The code prioritizes survival by eating known safe foods when carrying (to prevent starvation while holding items) or carrying them when free (to stockpile), uses a moderate hunger threshold to taste unknown fruits for information, and eats wholes only when starvation risk exceeds poisoning risk, avoiding unnecessary risks when full.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when critical hunger is reached, avoids known poisons, carries known safe fruits to build pantry reserves, and adopts a cautious "taste first" policy for unknown targets while ignoring unknowns unless desperate, thereby minimizing fatal risks from unpredictable chemistry changes.

The code prioritizes avoiding known poisons, uses trait-based inference for unknown fruits to reduce unnecessary tasting, and defaults to eating safe species while carrying items are handled efficiently.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starvation is imminent, avoids known poisonous species via diary history, and uses a cautious heuristic for unknown fruits: it tastes only if the ant is not starving (to afford potential harm) and the world isn't currently perceived as highly dangerous, otherwise opting to eat or leave to preserve health.

It prioritizes survival by eating unknowns only when starvation risk is high, tastes them to build safe knowledge base otherwise, and strictly avoids known poisons while preferring to carry confirmed safe fruits to the pantry.
